Toolkit

Everything a field engineer needs

A command-center of diagnostics and controls, offline-first by design.

🧭

Command-Center Dashboard

Live connectivity (Wi-Fi, cellular, VPN, Ethernet, metered), interface details — IPv4/IPv6, gateway, MTU — quick-launch tool tiles and an explanation engine.

🛠️

Core Diagnostics

Ping with jitter & loss, DNS lookups (A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT/CNAME + PTR), an HTTP/HTTPS builder with DNS→TLS→first-byte timing breakdown, speed tests.

📶

WiFi & Signal Analyzer

Live band, link speed, BSSID and security, nearby network scans, and a precise room-by-room signal mapper.

🧪

LAN, IP & Protocol Lab

Subnet / IPv4 CIDR and IPv6 calculators, advanced IPv6 analysis (multicast scope, embedded v4, NAT64), mDNS/UPnP discovery and Wake-on-LAN.

🧠

Intelligent Engine

Rule-based diagnostics on an Evidence → Inference → Action model with confidence levels, custom JSON rules and professional reports (Markdown, JSON, HTML).

🔐

Privacy by Default

Masked IPs, MACs and SSIDs with one-tap reveal, encrypted on-device key storage (AES-256-GCM), no cloud required, and reports you fully control.

📈

Monitor & Control

Live system monitor with a foreground-service notification and home-screen widget, plus Quick Settings tiles (Scan, Monitor, Speed, Port, Firewall).

🛡️

App Firewall (No-Root)

A local VPN-based firewall that blocks selected apps entirely by dropping their traffic on-device — no byte ever leaves your phone.

👥

Accounts & Sync

Google Sign-In, history synced under your own user scope, projects shared with teams — while anonymous, fully offline use needs no account.

🤖 Built-in AI

The AI Network Analyst

Turns raw scan results into plain-language answers, root-cause analysis and professional reports — your keys, stored on your device.

  • Analyze — break a scan or result into a clear, structured diagnosis
  • Explain — plain-language meaning of every number and field
  • Troubleshoot — step-by-step fix guidance based on detected symptoms
  • Report — a complete diagnostic report as Markdown, JSON or HTML

🧪 Early Access

Become a tester

Network Copilot v5.0.4 is in closed tester release across Android 10–16 (API 29–36), from narrow phones to tablets.

Which devices are covered?

Android 10–16 (API 29–36), from narrow phones to tablets. Testers report crashes automatically via Firebase Crashlytics.

What's next on the roadmap?

Public launch (production ad units, FCM push, scoped settings), tester-loop hardening, engineering v4 (deeper SNMP/UPnP, on-device AI inference) and team analytics.

Is my data uploaded?

No. Diagnostics run on your device; nothing leaves it unless you explicitly export or share a report.
